Population increased in Haringey

The estimated population of Haringey in 2024 was 263,850 usual residents, a rise of 0.2% since 2023.

This meant that Haringey's rate of population change placed it among the slowest growing 20 percent of local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Haringey decreased by 0.2%.

Over this slightly longer period, Haringey was among one of only five local authorities in England and Wales where the population got smaller.

Age profile of Haringey

The average (median) age stayed at 36.4 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Haringey has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Haringey is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Haringey's population of 263,850 usual residents was made up of:

  • 47,371 people aged 0 to 15 years, (18%)
  • 186,728 people aged 16 to 64 years, (70.8%)
  • 29,751 people aged 65 years and over, (11.3%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Haringey has a higher proportion of people aged 16 to 64 years (70.8% compared with 62.8% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Haringey, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Haringey
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Haringey, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 1,847 people (0.7%). In total, there were 3,101 births and 1,254 deaths in Haringey.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) led to a fall in the population of 2,279 (-0.9%). There were 29,781 people entering the area and 32,060 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Haringey's population of 934 (0.4%) as a result of 5,899 people entering the area and 4,965 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Haringey was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Haringey in mid-2023 is 263,362.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 1,094 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 627 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 467 people.
